# judo-meta-keycloak

> An Eclipse/EMF metamodel and runtime library for Keycloak identity and access management configuration, part of the Judo framework for model-driven application development.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.8.7+ with Eclipse Tycho 4.0.13
- 6 Maven modules: core model, OSGi bundle, Eclipse feature/site, unit tests, integration tests
- Ecore metamodel defining Keycloak realm configurations (realms, clients, users, credentials, attribute bindings)
- EMF code generation via MWE2 workflows; Epsilon EVL for model validation; Jackson for JSON serialization
- Deployable as Eclipse plugin (P2 update site) or standalone OSGi bundle (Apache Karaf 4.4.7)
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with architecture diagrams, build commands, and configuration
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with directory structure, build commands, and coding conventions
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD workflow and branching strategy documentation

## Modules — Core

- [model/pom.xml](model/pom.xml): Eclipse plugin containing the Ecore metamodel, EMF-generated code, and hand-written runtime classes for validation, JSON export, and Jackson deserialization
- [model/model/keycloak.ecore](model/model/keycloak.ecore): Ecore metamodel defining Realm, Client, User, UserCredential, and AttributeBinding entity types

## Modules — Distribution

- [osgi/pom.xml](osgi/pom.xml): Standalone OSGi bundle for Karaf deployments with embedded Epsilon validation rules and automatic model discovery via BundleTracker
- [feature/feature.xml](feature/feature.xml): Eclipse feature definition for IDE installation
- [site/pom.xml](site/pom.xml): Eclipse P2 update site for "Install New Software"

## Modules — Testing

- [model-test/pom.xml](model-test/pom.xml): JUnit 5 unit tests for KeycloakUtils, KeycloakConfigurationExporter, KeycloakEpsilonValidator, and model execution context
- [osgi-itest/pom.xml](osgi-itest/pom.xml): Pax Exam integration tests verifying model loading, service registration, and validation in an Apache Karaf container
